title: The Asuka and Fujiwara Palace Complexes Declared UNESCO World Heritage
summary: Japan adds its twenty-second World Heritage site with the official inscription of these ancient imperial palaces.

title: Tenth anniversary of attack on Yamayuri disability center in Sagamihara commemorated
summary: Tributes and reflection on discrimination mark ten years since the tragedy that left 19 dead.

title: Trump ordered and then canceled a military attack on Iran, according to reports
summary: The US president reportedly gave the order to attack but retracted amid rising tensions with Iran.

title: Vehicle hits crowd at LGBTQ+ event in Berlin, killing one and injuring several
summary: The driver struck attendees of a celebration in central Berlin, in an incident that authorities are investigating as a possible intentional attack.

title: Iguchi takes over as new manager of the Japanese baseball team (Samurai Japan)
summary: The former Major Leaguer becomes the first national team manager with experience in the Major Leagues and will make his debut in November.

title: Japan promotes adoption of artificial intelligence in local governments
summary: The Ministry of Internal Affairs will examine tasks that AI can replace and launch model projects in Hamamatsu and Kobe.

title: Jungle Okinawa theme park fails to meet visitor targets in its first year
summary: The CEO acknowledged that the number of visitors was lower than expected, while experts analyze the reasons for the performance.
